title: Authorization Failure Errors Connecting to the Slack MCP Sever

updates.body: We are aware that customers are receiving authorization failure errors when trying to connect to the Slack MCP server. We are currently investigating the issue and will provide an update as soon as more information becomes available. We're very sorry for any inconvience this may be causing your business.

We continue to investigate the issue. At this time, it appears the impact is affecting users of certain third party Slack integrations. We’ll continue to provide updates as more information becomes available, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may be causing.

We have resolved the issue that was causing users to experience authorization failures when connecting certain third-party integrations to Slack.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and thank you for your patience.

updates.body: We are aware of an issue impacting Slack. As a result, some customers may be unable to load certain features, including activity and notification badge counts, and may encounter errors when using the service. We are working to resolve this as our highest priority, and we'll provide another update in 30 minutes.

The team is investigating the issue and have rolled back a recent feature change to reduce load on affected systems. We are also actively increasing infrastructure capacity to restore normal service levels. We'll provide an update in 30 minutes or sooner if additional information becomes available.

Intermittent errors when sending messages have been resolved. Additionally, some customers may see inaccurate notification badge counts which can be resolved with a hard reload to clear temporary local cache. Apologies for the trouble today and thank you for your patience.

title: Issue with Sending and Receiving Messages

updates.body:
We're investigating a new incident.
Current impact to end users: Some users may experience elevated error rates and message-related degradations when sending and receiving messages across the Slack platform
Teams are actively engaged to identify the root cause and remediate the service impact and will provide updates as information is available.
We apologize for the inconvenience and will continue sharing updates as they become available.

We’re continuing to investigate the issue. We have identified two affected shards that are becoming overloaded, causing elevated query failures and message-related degradations. We are in the process of testing a potential fix. We’ll provide the next update once new information becomes available.

A fix has been deployed to the affected shards. ProcessMessage jobs had been paused, and these have now been unpaused on the affected shards. We are monitoring performance to assess whether the shards have returned to expected performance levels.
Following a period of monitoring, our engineering team called this incident resolved as of 01:10 UTC, March 30. We apologize for any inconvenience this issue has caused to users.
